Markets.title: Dow, S&P 500 slip as oil hovers near $100 despite Nasdaq’s record close
Markets.summary: The Dow and S&P 500 fell sharply as oil prices neared $100 per barrel and caused investor concern. Meanwhile, strong performances from Micron Technology and artificial intelligence companies drove the Nasdaq to a record close.

Markets.title: US economy firming as inflation risks persist, says Richmond Fed’s Tom Barkin
Markets.summary: Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin stated that the U.S. economy remains resilient due to strong consumer spending and broad growth. He noted that inflation continues to be a greater concern than labor market weaknesses, following the Federal Reserve's recent interest rate hike.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities reversed early gains on Tuesday, with the Sensex falling 330 points and the Nifty closing lower amid high volatility. F&O expiry, foreign outflows, geopolitical uncertainty, IT sector pressure, and high crude prices drove the market decline.

Markets.title: Hill-house backed Elevate Campuses raises Rs 945-crore anchor book
Markets.summary: Elevate Campuses raised Rs 945 crore from 20 anchor investors, securing 60% of its qualified institutional buyer allocation. The Hillhouse-backed company's Rs 2,100 crore IPO opens on Wednesday and closes on Friday.

Markets.title: Runwal Enterprises sets IPO price band at Rs 290-305 per share
Markets.summary: Runwal Enterprises has set its IPO price band at Rs 290 to Rs 305 per share. The Rs 500 crore fresh issue opens on Friday and closes on September 29.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Finolex Cables among 3 stock recommendations for Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian markets recovered from intraday lows as crude oil prices fell and Brent crude slipped below $100 a barrel. Analysts recommended BlueStone Jewellery, JSW Infrastructure, and Finolex Cables as stocks with bullish momentum and breakout setups for Wednesday.

Geo-Political.title: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran in UN speech as officials meet on sidelines
Geo-Political.summary: During his UN speech, U.S. President Trump threatened to annihilate Iran while weighing a potential peace deal against extreme military action. Meanwhile, diplomatic officials met on the sidelines of the event to discuss the escalating tensions.

Geo-Political.title: Burnham expects to find 'common ground' with Trump in first meeting
Geo-Political.summary: Prime Minister Burnham is traveling to New York to meet with Donald Trump and aims to find common ground with him. During the trip, Burnham will also deliver a speech focused on artificial intelligence at the UN General Assembly.

Geo-Political.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
Geo-Political.summary: The United States and Denmark signed a new defense deal at the UN General Assembly to build two military bases in Greenland. The agreement also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over the semi-autonomous Arctic territory.

Geo-Political.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
Geo-Political.summary: Morocco's upcoming election features campaigns targeting young voters through football slogans, job promises, and anti-Israel rallying cries. These political strategies incorporate local and international issues, including the geopolitical status of Ceuta, to influence the electorate.

Geo-Political.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
Geo-Political.summary: A Sri Lankan court has convicted 15 men for their involvement in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings. The coordinated attacks targeted three churches and three luxury hotels, resulting in 270 deaths.

Geo-Political.title: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak
Geo-Political.summary: Scientists report that the developing El Niño has become the strongest on record. Weather impacts from this climate phenomenon are already affecting regions around the world.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to help digital creators improve and streamline their work in 2025. It explains that adopting these technologies is now necessary for creators who want to keep pace with a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights 10 advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and improve workplace efficiency. These widely used market solutions cater to various applications, including natural language processing, to increase overall productivity across different industries.

AI & Tech.summary: The article explores various AI content generator tools available in 2022 to help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material. It aims to help readers navigate the market and choose the right writing software for their specific needs.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how the CJ Affiliate network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative networks.

Data & Insights.title: Strong pace of economic growth seen in June quarter to continue, says FM
Data & Insights.summary: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman states that India's strong economic growth from the June quarter will continue. She notes that the Union Budget presented on February 1 will support this growth rate through 2026.

Data & Insights.title: Charges, framework, dedicated fund — How MDR on UPI works for micro and small merchants, explained
Data & Insights.summary: Starting October 15, a 0.4% merchant discount rate applies to person-to-merchant UPI transactions exceeding ₹2,000. This article explains how these new charges, the regulatory framework, and a dedicated fund impact small and micro merchants.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon flags India's 'inconsistent application of taxes': What the JPMorgan CEO said about Indian economy
Data & Insights.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon criticized India for its inconsistent application of tax regulations. Foreign investors have long raised concerns about these unpredictable tax policies alongside the country's relatively high taxes.

Data & Insights.title: Saudi oil shock could hit Asian refiners through prices and freight before crude runs out
Data & Insights.summary: Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline has resumed operations after a shutdown that disrupted its crude export network. This restart has eased fears of a prolonged supply shortage for Asian refiners.

Data & Insights.title: FM asks entrepreneurs to build not just bigger, but better companies
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman urged corporate leaders to build companies that conceive, design, and develop products in India for the global market. She emphasized creating an ecosystem that goes beyond mere manufacturing to foster domestic innovation.

Data & Insights.title: China has what Trump needs for AI race: Why Beijing’s rare earths may matter more than tariffs at Trump-Xi summit
Data & Insights.summary: Upcoming talks between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping highlight China's dominance over rare earth elements essential for artificial intelligence. The United States is currently pushing to develop alternative supply sources, such as exploring deposits in Greenland.

India.title: Man Shoots Wife, 2 Priests In UP's Azamgarh, Takes 2 Children Hostage
India.summary: A man in Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh, shot and injured his wife and two priests. He then took his two children hostage and locked himself in a room as police worked to rescue them.

India.title: 4 Months On, No FIR Yet In Vaishno Devi's Rs 550 Crore-Silver 'Scandal'
India.summary: Four months after a complaint alleged the pilferage and adulteration of Rs 550 crore in silver offerings at the Vaishno Devi shrine, authorities have not yet filed an FIR. Advocate Deepak Sharma filed the original complaint regarding the missing offerings made by devotees.

India.title: 'Need The Money Now': Rs 700-Crore Mylapore Fund Scam Victims Demand Fast-Track Justice
India.summary: Victims of the Rs 700-crore Mylapore Hindu Permanent Fund Nidhi scam are demanding fast-track justice so they can recover their money. Entrepreneur and politician Devanathan Yadav, who headed the fund, has been arrested in connection with the case.

India.title: Dance, Liquor Videos: Bihar Groping Horror Accused's Facebook Timeline
India.summary: The Facebook timeline of Nandan Yadav, an accused in the Bihar groping horror, features multiple videos of him and his friends posing aggressively. These shared videos also include footage of dancing and liquor.

India.title: Why Maharashtra Minister Has Warned Of A Potential 100% Drought Situation
India.summary: A Maharashtra minister has warned of a potential 100% drought situation in the state. This warning comes as Maharashtra emerges as one of India's worst-hit states by drought this September.

India.title: From Vacancies To Appointments: Where UP's 9.5 Lakh Government Jobs Landed
India.summary: Samajwadi Party President Akhilesh Yadav has criticized Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath regarding high unemployment rates and a shortage of youth employment in Uttar Pradesh. The article examines the actual distribution and placement of the 9.5 lakh government jobs filled in the state.

General.title: Trump says he can do business with Burnham but criticises 'terrible' Chagos deal
General.summary: Donald Trump stated he can work with Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham but strongly criticized the UK's proposed agreement to hand the Chagos Islands over to Mauritius. Under the controversial deal, the UK plans to lease back the strategically important military base located on Diego Garcia.

General.title: Watch: Burnham 'gets it' says Trump, as the two leaders meet for first time
General.summary: Donald Trump met Andy Burnham for the first time in New York and stated that he can do business with the Greater Manchester mayor. During the meeting, Trump also criticized the UK government's recent Chagos Islands agreement, calling the deal "terrible."

General.title: Plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community disrupted, say police
General.summary: Counter-terrorism police in Manchester arrested two men on Sunday. The arrests were made to disrupt a planned plot targeting the local Jewish community.

General.title: Tim Westwood charged with two more sexual offences
General.summary: Tim Westwood has been charged with two additional sexual offences alleged to have occurred in 1991 and 2004. These new charges bring further legal action against the British DJ and broadcaster.

General.title: Earl Spencer should pull Diana book from shelves, Piers Morgan says
General.summary: Piers Morgan is pursuing legal action against Princess Diana's brother, Earl Spencer, following a factual error in Spencer's memoir. Morgan stated that Spencer should pull the book from bookstore shelves as a result of the error.

General.title: Father admits causing death of his son in hotel fall
General.summary: A father has admitted to causing the death of his two-year-old son, who fell from a Cyprus hotel window in July. A court in Paphos heard the details of the case.
